name: Wo yu Ni Gongdu de Qiri
source:
Awakening with lost memories,you found myself imprisoned in an unfamiliar room.

And before you appeared—a peculiar girl.

She declared you her most important person, insisting this room was your sanctuary.

This is a tale of a hollow amnesiac and a cage-weaving enigmatic girl—fates forever entwined.

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3946810/The_seven_days_i_spent_with_you/]Steam[/url]]
translation:
带着失去的记忆醒来，你发现自己被囚禁在一个陌生的房间里。

而在你出现之前——一个奇特的女孩。

她宣称你是她最重要的人，并坚称这个房间是你的避难所。

这是一个关于空洞失忆症患者和编织笼子的神秘女孩的故事——命运永远交织在一起。

[来自[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3946810/The_seven_days_i_spent_with_you/]Steam[/url]]
